events.verdict: Towns (NYK) places his hand against Daniels' (ATL) side and immediately removes it. Any follow-through contact by Towns is marginal.
Niang (ATL) moves laterally along with Brunson (NYK) on the perimeter and the body contact is marginal.
Young (ATL) stops short and Achiuwa (NYK) continues moving forwards into him, initiating body contact that affects his shot attempt.
Daniels (ATL) moves alongside Brunson's (NYK) path to the basket and the body contact is marginal.
Achiuwa (NYK) and Towns (NYK) legally contest Young's (ATL) driving shot attempt.
Daniels (ATL) legally contests Brunson's (NYK) jump shot attempt.
Okongwu (ATL) is drawn into the air on the pump fake by Achiuwa (NYK), but he maintains a legal vertical position.
Niang (ATL) moves underneath Hart (NYK) and initiates illegal contact that prevents him from controlling the rebound.
Daniels (ATL) briefly places an arm against Bridges (NYK) before making clean contact with the ball to steal the throw-in.
Towns (NYK) extends his forearm into Daniels' (ATL) body, affecting his shot attempt at the basket.
Towns (NYK) makes marginal contact to Okongwu's (ATL) wrist as he gathers the loose ball.
Hart (NYK) moves laterally into Young (ATL), affecting his SQBR and causing him to lose control of the ball.
Daniels (ATL) legally contests Brunson's (NYK) jump shot attempt.
Young (ATL) gathers the ball on his right foot and legally takes two steps before establishing coming to a stop. He then legally pivots off of his foot before making the pass.
Daniels (ATL) cleanly deflects the ball away from Brunson (NYK).
Achiuwa (NYK) fumbles the ball and legally recovers it before making the pass.
Okongwu (ATL) firms up in a screening position in Bridges' (NYK) path and does not deliver contact.
Towns (NYK) intentionally kicks the ball.
Young (ATL) does not dislodge Bridges (NYK) from his defensive position as the two players come together.
Bridges (NYK) deflects the ball out of bounds.
Brunson (NYK) moves laterally into Daniels (ATL) and initiates body contact that affects his SQBR.
Daniels (ATL) is moving alongside of Brunson (NYK) on the perimeter and the body contact is marginal. Brunson loses control of the ball as he attempts to stop and change directions.
Coach Thibodeau (NYK) signals for and is granted a timeout request while Brunson (NYK) is in sole possession of the ball.
Achiuwa (NYK) and Okongwu (ATL) make incidental leg contact with each other in transition.
Achiuwa (NYK) turns and initiates illegal contract with Okongwu (ATL) during his layup attempt.
Daniels (ATL) legally contests Brunson's (NYK) jump shot attempt.
Okongwu (ATL) firms up in a screening position and the contact with Shamet (NYK) is marginal.

Bridges (NYK) briefly places a hand on Young's (ATL) side and immediately removes it without affecting Young's SQBR. After correcting, he maintains a legal guarding position during Young's driving shot attempt.
Okongwu's (ATL) momentum is carrying him forward and any contact by Towns (NYK) and Achiuwa (NYK) during the rebound is marginal.
